# DMD Gold

> DMD Gold is jewellery management software for Indian jewellery retailers, wholesalers and manufacturers, built in Pune by a jeweller with 25+ years in the trade. It is made only for the jewellery industry and has a deliberately simple interface that shop owners and counter staff without a technical background can use. Trusted by 500+ jewellery shops.

Pricing: Retailer Edition ₹6,000/year; Wholesaler Edition ₹12,000/year; support included.
Contact: +91 93711 23699 (phone/WhatsApp), info@dmdgold.com. Office: Wagholi, Pune, Maharashtra.

## Features
- [Custom order management](https://www.dmdgold.com/features/custom-order-management): create orders, confirm, assign each item to karigars with return dates, job cards and customer receipts
- [Karigar gold tracking](https://www.dmdgold.com/features/karigar-gold-tracking): issue/receive challans, fine-gold balance, ghat
- [HUID & stock tracking](https://www.dmdgold.com/features/huid-hallmark-tracking): HUID per item, barcode tags, scan stock-take
- [GST billing & e-invoice](https://www.dmdgold.com/features/gst-e-invoice-jewellery): gold rate, making charges, URD old-gold exchange, one-click IRN e-invoice
- [B2B wholesale order app](https://www.dmdgold.com/features/b2b-wholesale-order-app): retailers order from wholesalers online
- [Jewellery CRM](https://www.dmdgold.com/features/jewellery-crm): customer register, purchase history per customer, birthday offers, retailer payment history for wholesalers
- [Purchase history](https://www.dmdgold.com/features/purchase-history): record what was bought, from whom and when
- [Pricing](https://www.dmdgold.com/pricing)
